customer_id.meaning: primary id of the customer profile (seed uuid)

name.meaning: legal name of the individual customer, or the registered business name of a fleet customer, exactly as on the profile

customer_type.meaning: whether the profile belongs to a retail individual buyer/owner or to a business that operates a fleet under a commercial account

phone.meaning: primary phone number on file for the customer

email.meaning: email address on file for the customer

home_zip.meaning: ZIP code of the customer's billing (home or business) address on file

id_last4.meaning: last four characters of the driver's license number (individual) or of the federal EIN (fleet business) recorded when the profile was created

residence_state.meaning: US state of the customer's billing address on file

profile_opened_date.meaning: date the customer profile was first created at any store of the group

store_id.meaning: primary id of the dealership store (rooftop) record

store_code.meaning: short code of the store, used as the key of every per-store schedule in the product charters

store_name.meaning: official trading name of the store

state.meaning: US state in which the store is licensed as a dealer

city.meaning: city of the store's street address

vehicle_id.meaning: primary id of the vehicle record (one per VIN)

customer_id.meaning: customer who owns the vehicle, or who is the buyer named on an open deal for it; empty for unsold stock

model.meaning: model name, e.g. RAV4 or F-150

trim.meaning: trim level as printed on the window sticker

vehicle_condition.meaning: condition class of the vehicle when last sold by the group (or as stocked, for unsold units)

in_service_date.meaning: date the vehicle was first delivered to a retail or fleet owner (the factory warranty start date); empty for a new unit never delivered

msrp.meaning: manufacturer's suggested retail price from the window sticker (new) or the original MSRP as decoded from the VIN (used)

usage_class.meaning: registered use of the vehicle: personal/family use or business/commercial use

title_brand.meaning: brand on the vehicle's current certificate of title

verification_id.meaning: primary id of the identity verification record (content hash of the customer)

verified.meaning: whether identity verification passed; monotonically non-decreasing

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: moment of the most recent verification attempt

handoff_id.meaning: primary id of the human-handoff record

reason.meaning: reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

purchase_deal_id.meaning: primary id of the vehicle purchase deal (one per buyer's order on one vehicle)

variant_name.meaning: deal type held, written as the official full deal-type name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the deal (basis defined in the purchase charter lifecycle)

deal_number.meaning: deal number printed on the buyer's order, e.g. KTD-26-10871

reserved_date.meaning: date the reservation deposit was taken and the vehicle was placed on hold (the deal's opening date)

hold_expires_date.meaning: last calendar day on which the vehicle remains on hold for this buyer, including any extensions granted

hold_extension_count.meaning: number of hold extensions granted on this deal so far

contract_date.meaning: date the buyer's order (and any installment contract) was signed; empty while only reserved

delivery_date.meaning: date the buyer took possession of the vehicle (spot or final delivery); empty until delivered

closed_date.meaning: date the deal reached a terminal state (closed, cancelled, released or unwound); empty while open

cash_price.meaning: agreed selling price of the vehicle before documentary fee, government fees, taxes, trade-in and deposits

trade_in_allowance.meaning: amount allowed for the buyer's trade-in vehicle; 0.00 when there is no trade-in

trade_payoff_amount.meaning: lien payoff owed on the trade-in vehicle as quoted by its lienholder; 0.00 when there is no lien or no trade-in

trade_appraisal_date.meaning: date the trade-in vehicle was appraised; empty when there is no trade-in

trade_appraisal_odometer.meaning: trade-in odometer reading at appraisal; empty when there is no trade-in

financing_type.meaning: how the balance of the deal is paid: cash/own funds, a retail installment contract assigned to a lender by the store, a lender the buyer arranged, or commercial net terms

lienholder_name.meaning: name of the lender holding the lien on the purchased vehicle; empty for cash and net-terms deals

amount_financed.meaning: amount financed on the installment contract; 0.00 when not financed

lender_buy_rate.meaning: the lender's approved buy rate for the installment contract; empty when not financed

contract_apr.meaning: APR printed on the installment contract; empty when not financed

delivery_method.meaning: whether the buyer takes delivery at the store or the vehicle is delivered to the buyer's address

delivery_distance_miles.meaning: one-way road distance from the selling store to the delivery address as quoted by the store's routing; 0 for showroom delivery

odometer_at_delivery.meaning: odometer reading recorded on the odometer disclosure at delivery; empty until delivered

title_application_date.meaning: date the store filed the buyer's title application with the state; empty until filed

deposit_held_balance.meaning: deposit money currently held on this deal; identically the sum of the deposit_held account deltas

balance_due.meaning: amount still owed on the deal by the buyer or the buyer's lender; identically the sum of the deal_receivable account deltas

purchase_txn_id.meaning: primary id of the deal money transaction

purchase_deal_id.meaning: deal the transaction belongs to (foreign key -> purchase_deals)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, verbatim from the purchase charter

txn_date.meaning: business date the transaction was posted

amount.meaning: money amount of the transaction, always greater than 0.00; the direction is given by the event type, and a waived or zero charge is simply not posted

charge_code.meaning: what a posted or reversed charge is for; not_applicable on deposit and payment rows

payment_method.meaning: how money moved on deposit, payment, refund and returned-payment rows; not_applicable on charge rows

source_txn_id.meaning: the original transaction this row acts on (the deposit applied/refunded/forfeited, the payment returned or refunded, the charge reversed); empty on original rows

billing_month.meaning: calendar month a late balance fee is assessed for; empty on every other row

odometer_miles.meaning: odometer reading the row is based on (the exchange-return reading on an exchange mileage charge); empty where no reading applies

purchase_cancel_request_id.meaning: primary id of the buyer's cancellation, or exchange-return request

customer_id.meaning: buyer making the request (foreign key -> customers)

purchase_deal_id.meaning: deal the request concerns (foreign key -> purchase_deals)

request_type.meaning: what the buyer asks for: release a reservation, cancel a signed but undelivered deal, or return a delivered vehicle under the exchange policy

request_date.meaning: date the buyer signed the request

odometer_miles.meaning: odometer reading stated on an exchange-return request; empty for the other request types

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

service_account_id.meaning: primary id of the customer's service account (one per customer across all stores)

home_store_id.meaning: store where the account was opened and where fleet statements are issued (foreign key -> stores)

variant_name.meaning: service account tier held, written as the official full tier name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the service account (basis defined in the service charter lifecycle)

account_number.meaning: service account number printed on repair orders and statements, e.g. SA-418227

opened_date.meaning: date the account was opened; its anniversary is the rewards tier review date

closed_date.meaning: date the account was closed; empty while open

credit_limit.meaning: open-account credit limit granted to a commercial fleet account; 0.00 for retail tiers, which pay at pickup

open_balance.meaning: amount currently owed on the account across all repair orders; identically the sum of the service_receivable account deltas

rewards_points_balance.meaning: Owner Rewards points currently available; identically the sum of the rewards_points account deltas

service_line_id.meaning: primary id of one repair-order ledger line

service_account_id.meaning: service account the line belongs to (foreign key -> service_accounts)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, verbatim from the service charter

store_id.meaning: store that wrote the repair order (foreign key -> stores)

vehicle_id.meaning: vehicle the repair order is for (foreign key -> vehicles); empty on account-level rows (late fee, points expiry)

repair_order_number.meaning: repair order number printed on the customer's RO, e.g. RO 418237; empty on account-level rows

line_letter.meaning: concern line of the repair order the row belongs to (line A is the first concern); not_applicable on RO-level and account-level rows

line_date.meaning: business date the row was posted (for charges, the date the RO line was closed; for payments, the date received)

pay_type.meaning: basis on which the customer owes a labor, parts or diagnostic row: ordinary customer-pay work, or the deductible the customer owes on a repair otherwise paid under a service contract or a deductible-bearing warranty; work paid by a manufacturer warranty, recall, service contract or maintenance plan is recorded in those programs' own records, never as a row here

labor_hours.meaning: flat-rate labor hours billed on a labor or diagnostic row; 0.0 on other rows

labor_rate.meaning: posted customer-pay labor rate of the store used for the row, before any discount; 0.00 on non-labor rows

list_amount.meaning: undiscounted amount of a labor, diagnostic or parts row (labor hours times labor rate, or parts list price total); 0.00 on other rows

amount.meaning: money amount of the row after discounts; greater than 0.00 on every charge, credit and payment row (direction given by the event type; a waived amount is simply not posted); on a points redemption row the dollar value of the points redeemed; 0.00 only on points earned and points expired rows

quantity.meaning: count the fee is based on (tires disposed for a tire disposal fee, chargeable storage days for a storage fee); 0 on other rows

fee_code.meaning: which shop fee a service_shop_fee_charged row is; not_applicable on other rows

credit_reason.meaning: why a service_line_credited row was given; not_applicable on other rows

payment_method.meaning: how a payment (or a returned payment) was made; not_applicable on other rows

points.meaning: Owner Rewards points moved by a points row, always at least 1 (direction given by the event type); 0 on money rows

odometer_in.meaning: odometer reading written on the repair order at check-in; empty on account-level rows

source_line_id.meaning: the original row this row acts on (the charge a credit reduces, the payment returned); empty on original rows

billing_month.meaning: calendar month a late fee is assessed for, or the month in which expired points reached expiry; empty on other rows

service_auth_id.meaning: primary id of the customer's decision on a repair estimate

service_account_id.meaning: service account of the repair order (foreign key -> service_accounts)

repair_order_number.meaning: repair order number of the estimate

estimate_amount.meaning: customer-pay amount of the written estimate presented for the line (labor and parts after discounts, before shop fees)

decision.meaning: the customer's decision on the estimate

decided_date.meaning: date the customer gave the decision

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

maintenance_plan_id.meaning: primary id of the prepaid maintenance plan contract

vehicle_id.meaning: vehicle the plan covers (foreign key -> vehicles)

selling_store_id.meaning: store that sold the plan (foreign key -> stores)

purchase_deal_id.meaning: vehicle purchase deal the plan was sold with (foreign key -> purchase_deals); empty when bought on its own

variant_name.meaning: plan held, written as the official full plan name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the plan (basis defined in the maintenance charter lifecycle)

plan_number.meaning: plan contract number printed on the plan certificate, e.g. KC-2207714

sale_date.meaning: date the plan was sold; the term runs from this date

expiration_date.meaning: last calendar day of the plan term (sale date plus the plan's term months)

odometer_at_sale.meaning: vehicle odometer recorded on the plan contract at sale

expiration_odometer.meaning: odometer reading at which the plan term ends (odometer at sale plus the plan's term miles)

purchase_price.meaning: price the customer paid for the plan after any bundle or fleet volume discount

financed_on_contract.meaning: 'true' when the plan price was included in the amount financed on the vehicle's installment contract

lienholder_name.meaning: lender on the installment contract that financed the plan; empty when not financed

visits_remaining.meaning: plan visits still available; identically the sum of the plan_visits account deltas

refund_due_balance.meaning: cancellation refund computed but not yet paid; identically the sum of the cancellation_refund_due account deltas

closed_date.meaning: date the plan became fulfilled, expired or cancelled; empty while active

maintenance_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the plan ledger entry

maintenance_plan_id.meaning: plan the entry belongs to (foreign key -> maintenance_plans)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, verbatim from the maintenance charter

visits.meaning: plan visits moved by a visit entry, always at least 1 (direction given by the event type); 0 on refund entries

amount.meaning: money amount of a refund entry: on a refund calculation the refund computed (0.00 when the computation yields no refund), on a refund payment the amount paid (always greater than 0.00); 0.00 on visit entries

visit_number.meaning: which plan visit a redemption uses (the first visit redeemed is 1); 0 on other entries

repair_order_number.meaning: repair order on which a visit was redeemed; empty on other entries

store_id.meaning: store where a visit was redeemed (foreign key -> stores); empty on other entries

odometer.meaning: odometer at the visit (redemption) or stated on the cancellation request (refund calculation); empty otherwise

source_entry_id.meaning: the redemption a reinstatement reverses, or the refund calculation a refund payment pays; empty on original entries

cancel_reason.meaning: reason recorded on cancellation and refund entries; not_applicable otherwise

refund_payee.meaning: who receives a refund payment; not_applicable on other entries

maintenance_cancel_request_id.meaning: primary id of the plan holder's signed cancellation request

maintenance_plan_id.meaning: plan to be cancelled (foreign key -> maintenance_plans)

cancel_reason.meaning: reason the holder states on the cancellation form

request_date.meaning: date the holder signed the request; the cancellation is effective on this date

odometer_at_request.meaning: odometer the holder certifies on the request

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

vsc_contract_id.meaning: primary id of the vehicle service contract

purchase_deal_id.meaning: vehicle purchase deal the contract was sold on (foreign key -> purchase_deals); empty when sold later on its own

selling_store_id.meaning: store that sold the contract (foreign key -> stores)

variant_name.meaning: coverage level held, written as the official full coverage name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the contract (basis defined in the vsc charter lifecycle)

contract_number.meaning: contract number printed on the service contract, e.g. KS-7716042

term_start_date.meaning: date the term is counted from (the sale date, or the vehicle's in-service date where the coverage level counts from it)

term_start_odometer.meaning: odometer the term miles are counted from (the odometer at sale, or 0 where the term counts from the in-service date)

odometer_at_sale.meaning: odometer recorded on the contract at sale

term_months.meaning: term in months chosen from the coverage level's term options

term_miles.meaning: term in miles chosen from the coverage level's term options

expiration_date.meaning: last day of coverage (term start date plus term months)

expiration_odometer.meaning: odometer at which coverage ends (term start odometer plus term miles)

deductible_option.meaning: deductible chosen at sale, in whole US dollars

retail_price.meaning: price the customer paid for the contract

financed_on_contract.meaning: 'true' when the contract price was included in the amount financed on the vehicle's installment contract

lienholder_name.meaning: lender that financed the contract price; empty when not financed

claims_paid_total.meaning: total paid on claims under the contract, net of reversals; identically the sum of the claims_paid account deltas

refund_due_balance.meaning: cancellation refund computed but not yet paid; identically the sum of the vsc_refund_due account deltas

closed_date.meaning: date the contract was cancelled (the effective cancellation date) or expired; empty while active

vsc_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the service contract ledger entry

vsc_contract_id.meaning: contract the entry belongs to (foreign key -> vsc_contracts)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, verbatim from the vsc charter

entry_date.meaning: business date of the entry (claim decision date, refund date)

claim_number.meaning: claim authorization number issued for the repair visit, e.g. CLM-5520193; empty on refund entries

repair_order_number.meaning: repair order the claim pays; empty on refund entries

claim_line_type.meaning: which benefit a claim entry pays or denies; not_applicable on refund entries

component_group.meaning: component group of a component_repair claim line; not_applicable otherwise

odometer.meaning: odometer on the repair order (claims) or certified on the cancellation request (refund calculation); empty otherwise

labor_hours.meaning: labor hours allowed on a component repair line; 0.0 otherwise

labor_rate_paid.meaning: hourly labor rate the contract pays on the line (the store's rate up to the coverage level's cap); 0.00 otherwise

parts_amount.meaning: covered parts amount paid on a component repair line; 0.00 otherwise

deductible_applied.meaning: deductible taken from this claim line (owed by the customer to the store); 0.00 when none

days.meaning: rental or trip-interruption days paid on the line; 0 otherwise

amount.meaning: money amount of the entry: amount paid on a claim line, amount reversed, refund computed (0.00 when the computation yields no refund) or refund paid; 0.00 on a denied claim line

denial_reason.meaning: why a claim line was denied; not_applicable on every other entry

cancel_method.meaning: basis of a refund calculation; not_applicable on claim entries

refund_payee.meaning: who receives a refund payment; not_applicable otherwise

source_entry_id.meaning: the claim line a reversal undoes, or the refund calculation a payment pays; empty on original entries

vsc_cancel_request_id.meaning: primary id of the contract holder's signed cancellation request

vsc_contract_id.meaning: contract to be cancelled (foreign key -> vsc_contracts)

cancel_reason.meaning: reason the holder states on the cancellation form

request_date.meaning: date the holder signed the request; the cancellation is effective on this date

odometer_at_request.meaning: odometer the holder certifies on the request

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

gap_waiver_id.meaning: primary id of the GAP waiver addendum

customer_id.meaning: buyer and borrower who holds the waiver (foreign key -> customers)

vehicle_id.meaning: financed vehicle the waiver covers (foreign key -> vehicles)

purchase_deal_id.meaning: financed purchase deal whose installment contract carries the waiver (foreign key -> purchase_deals)

variant_name.meaning: waiver held, written as the official full waiver name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the waiver (basis defined in the gap charter lifecycle)

sale_date.meaning: date the waiver was sold (the installment contract date); the term runs from this date

loan_term_months.meaning: term of the installment contract the waiver is attached to; the waiver term equals it

expiration_date.meaning: last day of the waiver term (sale date plus loan_term_months)

retail_price.meaning: price charged for the waiver on the installment contract

amount_financed.meaning: amount financed on the installment contract at signing, the numerator of the loan-to-value check

vehicle_value_basis.meaning: vehicle value the loan-to-value cap is measured against (MSRP for a new vehicle, the NADA retail value at sale for a used one)

lienholder_name.meaning: lender holding the installment contract and the lien

loan_payoff_date.meaning: date the lienholder reported the installment contract paid in full or refinanced away; empty while the loan is open

benefits_paid_total.meaning: total GAP benefits paid under the waiver, net of reversals; identically the sum of the gap_benefits_paid account deltas

refund_due_balance.meaning: cancellation or termination refund computed but not yet paid; identically the sum of the gap_refund_due account deltas

closed_date.meaning: date the waiver left active status (claim settled, cancelled, terminated or expired); empty while active

gap_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the GAP waiver ledger entry

gap_waiver_id.meaning: waiver the entry belongs to (foreign key -> gap_waivers)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, verbatim from the gap charter

entry_date.meaning: business date of the entry (claim decision date, refund date)

claim_number.meaning: GAP claim number, e.g. GC-1182046; empty on refund entries

benefit_line_type.meaning: which benefit a claim entry pays or denies; not_applicable on refund entries

loss_type.meaning: kind of total loss the claim is for; not_applicable on refund entries

loss_date.meaning: date of the loss as stated in the primary insurer's settlement; empty on refund entries

settlement_date.meaning: date of the primary insurer's total-loss settlement letter; empty on refund entries

payoff_at_loss.meaning: lienholder's net payoff of the contract as of the loss date (simple interest to that date); 0.00 on refund entries

insurance_acv_settlement.meaning: actual cash value the primary insurer settled for, before its deductible; 0.00 on refund entries

insurance_deductible.meaning: deductible the primary insurer withheld from the settlement; 0.00 on refund entries

past_due_amounts.meaning: scheduled payments past due as of the loss date, from the lienholder's payoff letter; 0.00 on refund entries and where none applies

late_fees_and_charges.meaning: late fees and other charges in the payoff, from the lienholder's payoff letter; 0.00 on refund entries and where none applies

deferred_payments.meaning: payments deferred or extended by the lender and added to the payoff; 0.00 on refund entries and where none applies

addon_refunds_credited.meaning: refunds of cancelled products financed on the contract (service contract, maintenance plan) credited or due to the payoff; 0.00 on refund entries and where none applies

negative_equity_amount.meaning: negative trade equity carried into the amount financed, from the purchase deal; 0.00 on refund entries and where none applies

salvage_retention_value.meaning: salvage value the insurer deducted because the owner kept the vehicle; 0.00 when not retained; 0.00 on refund entries and where none applies

amount.meaning: money amount of the entry: benefit paid, benefit reversed, refund computed (0.00 when the computation yields no refund) or refund paid; 0.00 on a denied claim line

denial_reason.meaning: why a claim line was denied; not_applicable on every other entry

cancel_method.meaning: basis of a refund calculation; not_applicable on claim entries

refund_payee.meaning: who receives a refund payment; not_applicable otherwise

source_entry_id.meaning: the benefit line a reversal undoes, or the refund calculation a payment pays; empty on original entries

gap_cancel_request_id.meaning: primary id of the waiver holder's signed cancellation request

gap_waiver_id.meaning: waiver to be cancelled (foreign key -> gap_waivers)

cancel_reason.meaning: reason the holder states on the cancellation form

request_date.meaning: date the holder signed the request; the cancellation is effective on this date

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

warranty_coverage_id.meaning: primary id of one warranty or recall coverage registered on one vehicle

customer_id.meaning: current owner of the covered vehicle (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: coverage type, written as the official coverage name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the coverage (basis defined in the warranty charter lifecycle)

coverage_start_date.meaning: date the coverage term counts from (the vehicle's in-service date, or the delivery date for the dealer's used-vehicle warranty)

coverage_start_odometer.meaning: odometer the coverage miles count from (0 for factory coverages counted from the in-service date, the delivery odometer for the dealer's used-vehicle warranty)

expiration_odometer.meaning: odometer at which coverage ends; 0 when the coverage has no mileage limit

owner_sequence.meaning: whether the current owner is the vehicle's first retail owner or a later owner

claims_paid_total.meaning: total paid under the coverage net of debits; identically the sum of the warranty_claims_paid account deltas

closed_date.meaning: date the coverage expired or was voided; empty while active

warranty_claim_id.meaning: primary id of the warranty or recall ledger entry

warranty_coverage_id.meaning: coverage the entry belongs to (foreign key -> warranty_coverages)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, verbatim from the warranty charter

claim_date.meaning: business date of the entry (claim decision date; for a recall notice, the date the notice was recorded)

repair_order_number.meaning: repair order the claim pays; empty on recall notices and owner reimbursements

store_id.meaning: store that performed the work (foreign key -> stores); empty on recall notices and owner reimbursements

claim_type.meaning: what the entry records or pays

campaign_number.meaning: manufacturer recall campaign number (e.g. 24V-512) on recall notices, remedies and owner reimbursements; empty otherwise

notice_date.meaning: date the manufacturer mailed the owner notification letter for the campaign, on recall entries; empty otherwise

component_group.meaning: component group the entry concerns; not_applicable on rental entries

odometer.meaning: odometer on the repair order (claims) or on the owner's receipt (reimbursements); empty on recall notices

labor_hours.meaning: manufacturer labor-time hours allowed; 0.0 when none

labor_rate_reimbursed.meaning: warranty labor rate reimbursed to the store; 0.00 when none

parts_amount.meaning: parts amount paid including the reimbursed markup; 0.00 when none

deductible_charged.meaning: deductible owed by the customer on this claim; 0.00 when none

amount.meaning: amount paid by the coverage on a paid claim, or debited on a debit (greater than 0.00); 0.00 on recall notices and rejected claims

reject_reason.meaning: why a claim was rejected; not_applicable on every other entry

source_claim_id.meaning: the paid claim a debit takes back; empty otherwise

loaner_agreement_id.meaning: primary id of the courtesy transportation agreement

customer_id.meaning: customer driving the loaner (foreign key -> customers)

store_id.meaning: store that issued the loaner (foreign key -> stores)

repair_order_number.meaning: repair order of the customer's vehicle the loaner was issued for; empty for a fleet replacement unit issued under the fleet agreement

variant_name.meaning: loaner program, written as the official program name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the agreement (basis defined in the loaner charter lifecycle)

agreement_number.meaning: agreement number printed on the loaner agreement, e.g. LA-302184

pay_basis.meaning: who pays the daily cost of the loaner

daily_allowance_usd.meaning: daily rental allowance of the paying warranty or service contract; 0.00 for other pay bases

due_date.meaning: date the loaner is due back, including any extension

return_date.meaning: date the loaner was returned; empty while out

odometer_in.meaning: loaner odometer at return; empty while out

fuel_in_eighths.meaning: fuel level at return; empty while out

open_balance.meaning: amount the customer owes on the agreement; identically the sum of the loaner_receivable account deltas

closed_date.meaning: date the agreement was closed; empty until closed

loaner_charge_id.meaning: primary id of the loaner charge or payment entry

loaner_agreement_id.meaning: agreement the entry belongs to (foreign key -> loaner_agreements)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, verbatim from the loaner charter

charge_code.meaning: what a charge or waiver is for; not_applicable on payments

quantity.meaning: count the charge is based on (days, excess miles, eighths of fuel, tolls or citations); 1 for flat charges; 0 on payments

unit_rate.meaning: rate per unit used for the charge; the flat amount for flat charges; 0.00 on payments

amount.meaning: money amount of the entry, always greater than 0.00 (direction given by the event type)

toll_reference.meaning: toll authority transaction or citation number a toll or citation charge passes on; empty otherwise

payment_method.meaning: how a payment was made; not_applicable on charges and waivers

source_charge_id.meaning: the charge a waiver reduces; empty otherwise
